intent: A drowned moonlit glade of dark blue-black woods and pale green-grey stone, with one cold silver-teal pool of light in a wide ring of standing stones at its heart, ruined watchtowers ringing the rims, still black pools and low blue-grey mist.
requests: A ring path for set pieces, so the well's light can crackle around its own stone ring instead of a seeded worm wandering off it.
A composite sculpt kind joining a waystone ring and a pool in one prop, so the well reads as stone round still water in a single placement.
A lantern-crowned tower kind, so the dead lanterns on the rims are towers with glazed tops rather than plain watchtowers.
